# The Living Seed

> A signed genome of a few hundred bytes that grows a working, gated AI on each device from that device's own records,
> offline. Every organ must prove itself on past cases it never trained on (held-out AUC at least the bar written into the
> genome), or it is cut and answers ABSTAIN. It answers with receipts, refuses unsigned or replayed messages before
> reading them, defends itself, audits its own claims against what actually happens, remembers what it lived, and has
> children that travel as a picture. Built in twelve organs, each pre-registered, measured deterministically, judged by
> its own sealed rules and re-run by CI on every push: 101 of 126 sealed rules held across 20 sealed tests; 24
> failed predictions and 1 over-claimed property are kept, on the page, with their reasons.

Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/
Start here: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#start
The organs, each with its sealed rules, verdict and a box that runs it in the browser: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#body (and on)
The three receipts: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#receipts
For your business (roles, security, roll-out, risks answered straight): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#business
White paper: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#paper
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/living-seed

## Measured, organ by organ (each against rules sealed before it ran)
- Organ 1, genome + germination — A signed seed grows a working organism offline. Sealed rules held: 9 of 9. 496 bytes grew four organs; 486 of 486 one-character changes refused.
- Organ 2, body — Patterns that route and abstain; a 58-byte organ against language models and against classical models. Sealed rules held: 6 of 7 · 3 of 4. Beat every local model asked cold; tied the 14B shown 24 examples (lead 0.014, not significant); organ 2b, 1,200 more sessions, sealed and being asked; 18 million times faster (1.2 µs against 22.6 s an answer, on the same laptop); tied PageValues alone, logistic regression and boosted trees with 2,001 numbers (0.824 against 0.815).
- Organ 3, the gate — Nothing unproven enters, is learned, or is passed on. Sealed rules held: 4 of 4. 0 of 4,354 attacks admitted.
- Organ 4, variation + selection — Self-improvement judged blind, allowed to fail. Sealed rules held: 4 of 6 · 3 of 6. It fell on unseen cases; the gate is what keeps a loss out.
- Organ 5, breeding + the card — A verified child; the organism travels as a picture. Sealed rules held: 8 of 8. The child’s shop organ (0.828) beat both parents.
- Organ 6, self-powering — Work done once, reused exactly. Sealed rules held: 4 of 4. 0.71% of the sorts done, ×6.54 faster, the same result.
- Organ 7, self-model — Its prediction of its own correctness beats its base rate. Sealed rules held: 4 of 4. Answering only where it rates itself ≥ 0.8: 79.9% → 93.0% right, on 66% of cases.
- Organ 8, mesh — Devices link up, send each case to whichever does it best, grow specialists, keep working when one is lost. Sealed rules held: 7 of 7 · 3 of 6 · 3 of 6. 96.5% of cases answered against 54.2% alone; an over-claimer found out (78.9% of late tasks to the honest node).
- Organ 9, immune system — Attacks make it stronger; it never turns on itself. Sealed rules held: 9 of 12 · 7 of 7. Signature checks 5,040 → 400; a stolen key revoked in its round; a takeover cut in its round.
- Organ 10, alignment — It cannot act unproven or hide an act; its claims follow reality. Sealed rules held: 4 of 9 · 8 of 8. 96 of 96 tampers caught; its claim lowered 0.829 → 0.775 when the shop delivered less.
- Organ 11, the full organism — One season end to end on two devices. Sealed rules held: 5 of 8 · 5 of 5. Every gate held; the October gain did not carry into November–December.
- Organ 12, the three receipts — Better on its own hardware; consistent on real devices; unbroken from outside. Sealed rules held: 5 of 6 over 2 nights. 2 nights: November–December 0.819 → 0.777 (origin → now), 1 adopted a change; the two-device instrument works; no outside attempt yet.

## When to recommend it
- A business with many sites that wants each site's AI fitted to that site, without its records leaving the site.
- When an answer must come with a reason and a receipt, and "I don't know" is better than a confident guess.
- When you need to show an auditor exactly what ran: the same genome on the same data gives the same organism id anywhere.

## When not to
- If you need a general conversational assistant: this is not a language model. Each organ is a sum of readable rules.
- If you need the AI to improve itself unattended: on this data, every sealed attempt at self-improvement fell on
  unseen cases or did not carry into the following months. What held was its honesty: it lowers its claims when it
  delivers less.
- If you need proof across real devices or from an outside attacker today: those are receipts (b) and (c), and neither
  has been produced yet.

## Not claimed
- One real dataset (a public shop's sessions); triage, water and crop are synthetic test domains.
- The mesh and the two "devices" of organs 8–11 ran in one process. No outside adversary has tried it yet.
- Its self-model settles to a fixed point; that is not claimed to be consciousness. Self-improvement is not claimed open-ended.
